title: Phone call via contact mic (2 speakers, unnamed request)

segments.speaker: Rosa
segments.text: Riverside Clinic, this is Rosa. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Hi, I need to move my physio appointment from Tuesday to Friday morning.

segments.speaker: Rosa
segments.text: Friday at nine thirty is open. I'll move you to that slot.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Perfect. Also my insurance changed, I have a new member card.

segments.speaker: Rosa
segments.text: Then please bring the new insurance card on Friday so we can update your file.

summary:
## Summary
- Sam asked to move the physio appointment from Tuesday to Friday.
- Rosa said the insurance changed and there is a new member card.
## Action items
- Rosa: move Sam's appointment to Friday at nine thirty.
- Rosa: bring the new insurance card on Friday.
